name: The Lost Supplies
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
This barrel is small yet sturdy.  Its seams are sealed with a yellow, pungent wax.  Stamped on the bottom of the barrel are the words:

QUARTERMASTER LUNGERTZ

NETHERGARDE KEEP
narrative.objectives: Bring the Lost Supplies to Quartermaster Lungertz.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, thank you adventurer! So many supplies are lost from Darkshire to here. It's good to see that some are recovered.
